title: Deadline and Protocol
author: Felix Thornbury
blurb: Jonah Oyelaran, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
